headline: JPMorgan Says Bradesco Shares Oversold After Recent Downgrades
summary: Following multiple cuts from other institutions, JPMorgan evaluated Banco Bradesco shares as oversold and reinforced a buy rating.
why: Banco Bradesco is one of Brazil's largest private-sector banks, and analyst rating shifts influence institutional investment flows in Latin American equities.

impacts.name: Banco Bradesco
impacts.why: Brokerage buy ratings can influence investor demand for specific equities.
